beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:85.title: Group CPO
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:85.description: Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll be joining Beacon's Portfolio Product team as a Group CPO, owning product strategy and execution across a defined vertical within our portfolio. You'll start as a player-coach, directly embedded in 2-3 portfolio companies while building and eventually leading a team of PMs as your vertical grows. This is a senior, high-ownership role for someone who wants to shape how an entire industry segment gets transformed through AI and software. You'll be responsible not just for outcomes at individual companies, but for developing the playbooks, frameworks, and institutional knowledge that scale across every business in your vertical. What works in one portco should make every other portco better. That's the job. This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system. Key Responsibilities - Own product strategy and outcomes across a defined vertical within Beacon's portfolio - Directly manage 2-3 portfolio companies as a hands-on PM while building toward a team of 3-5 PMs over time - Hire, onboard, and develop PMs within your vertical as the portfolio scales - Develop and codify cross-portfolio playbooks that turn individual wins into repeatable systems - Partner with GMs, founders, and operators to set product vision and translate it into executable roadmaps - Drive quarterly and annual planning across your vertical, ensuring consistency and quality of product thinking - Set the bar for how great product work looks at Beacon — spec quality, customer discovery, prioritization rigor - Collaborate with engineering, data, and GTM teams to ship and scale features across multiple companies simultaneously - Contribute to Beacon's broader AI platform by surfacing patterns and opportunities from your vertical What We're Looking For - BA/BS Degree, MBA a plus - 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a formal leadership role or as a co-founder - Proven ability to lead and develop PMs, not just do great PM work yourself - Deep B2B SaaS experience, ideally across multiple products or business contexts - Strong systems thinker — you see patterns across companies and know how to turn them into playbooks - Comfortable operating across multiple businesses and stakeholders simultaneously - Ability to influence and earn trust with founders and executives without direct authority - High autonomy, low ego. You figure things out and get them done - Entrepreneurial mindset and genuine comfort with ambiguity This role is perfect for you if... - You've led a product team or co-founded a company and want to apply that experience

locations: Springfield Regional Outpatient Surgery Center, LLC
compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.description: Location: Springfield Regional Outpatient Surgery Center, LLC Address: 2610 N Limestone St, Springfield, OH 45503 Website: https://springfieldosc.com/ Springfield Regional Outpatient Surgery Center (Springfield OSC) is a Medicare-certified, AAAHC-accredited ambulatory surgery center located in Springfield, Ohio. With four operating rooms and a procedure room, the center provides high-quality, cost-effective outpatient surgical care across specialties including orthopedics, sports medicine, digestive health, general surgery, spine, women’s health, plastic surgery, podiatry, and pain management. Owned and operated in partnership with local physicians, Springfield OSC combines advanced technology with compassionate, patient-centered care in a convenient setting. Role Summary: The Registered Nurse (RN) supports pre-op, PACU, and stepdown patient care at SROC. This position is responsible for assessing patients, delivering individualized nursing care, monitoring recovery, and collaborating with the surgical team to ensure safe, efficient procedures and optimal outcomes. Hours: Monday–Friday, part-time - min. 20hrs What You’ll do: - Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patient care in perioperative settings - Monitor patient status and respond to changes during recovery - Document accurately and communicate effectively with team members and patients - Maintain sterile environments and adhere to safety protocols - Support patient education and post-op instructions What You’ll bring: - Graduate of an accredited RN program - Current RN license (unencumbered) - Current BLS (ACLS required within 6 months) - Strong clinical judgment, communication, and teamwork skills Physical & Work Environment Requirements - Frequent standing, walking, lifting, and manual dexterity - Exposure to surgical environments, equipment, and patient care areas

jobgether-jobgether:lever:d0cac1c5-a0a4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst – Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration based in Poland. This role offers the opportunity to shape how sensitive data is stored, accessed, and protected across a complex enterprise environment. You will assess data sensitivity, system usage, workflows, and storage practices across multiple business areas. A key focus will be identifying high-risk use cases and determining where VDI, stronger access controls, or other secure solutions can provide the best protection. You will translate detailed analysis into practical recommendations, business cases, and migration roadmaps. Working closely with Security, Technology, and business stakeholders, you will help align solutions with data protection and governance requirements. The role combines business analysis, data security, infrastructure, and stakeholder management in a highly collaborative environment. Your work will directly support stronger data protection, informed technology decisions, and sustainable security practices. Partner with business groups across the organization to inventory systems, tools, endpoints, and data usage patterns associated with physical device storage. Assess and classify data sensitivity across business units, systems, processes, and workflows, identifying areas of heightened security risk. Analyze data and process flows across systems, servers, networks, and endpoints to support risk assessments and migration planning. Identify critical systems and high-risk data storage practices that should be prioritized for migration to VDI or other secure data management solutions. Document current-state and proposed future-state data storage, access, and usage models. Evaluate viable solutions, including VDI, enhanced access controls, and other secure data management approaches, and recommend the most appropriate option for each use case. Develop business cases and recommendations for VDI migration, considering risk, cost, operational impact, and user adoption. Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirements-gathering sessions across departments. Collaborate with Security, Technology, and business teams to validate findings and ensure recommendations align with applicable data policies. Present analysis, findings, and recommendations clearly to technology leadership and other key stakeholders. Support the development of a migration roadmap, including dependencies, priorities, adoption, and change management considerations. Contribute to the design and documentation of privileged access management (PAM) processes and frameworks as part of broader data security initiatives. Support the development of auditing and compliance review processes covering data usage, access controls, and end-to-end data security. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 5–7+ years of professional Business Analyst experience, ideally with a strong background in data governance, data classification or sensitivity assessments, secure data storage, or IT infrastructure and endpoint initiatives. Demonstrated experience working in complex, multi-platform, enterprise-level environments and analyzing systems usage and data flows across multiple business units. Familiarity with VDI concepts and platforms such as Citrix, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop, or a proven ability to quickly understand and work within new technical domains. Strong experience conducting stakeholder interviews, facilitating requirements-gathering sessions, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations. Ability to develop use cases, cost-benefit analyses, business cases, and executive-ready documentation.
